name: Carpathian Skies
source:
What does it mean to be a person when until recently, you didn’t exist?

When your body is woven from the stolen bones and fragmented minds of countless others, none of whom gave their consent? When the life you never asked for is a whispered curse, an abomination to many, and yet you are loved despite it all?

In Carpathian Skies, you awaken as a creation stitched together from the unwilling, a living patchwork haunted by memories that aren’t yours and bones you don't remember articulating. Your eyes, once belonging to the Grand Councilor, a beloved and near-mythic figure in Elsewhere, have been stolen and now reside in your skull. The High Council demands their return, but you are more than just a sentient storage container.

Sheltered aboard The Carpathia, a skyship crewed by privateers who navigate the fragile politics and perilous skies of Elsewhere, you must grapple with questions that cut deeper than the scalpels that dissected you: What is identity? What is choice? And can you carve a place to belong when your very existence defies nature?

From the capital city built around and in the neck of a dormant volcano to storm-churned cliffs and wyrm infested quarries, the island of Elsewhere is a gilded world rotting beneath its surface. As you chart your path through this world, you will forge alliances, uncover buried truths, and confront the question of what it truly means to be alive. And love - sharp, fragile, and dangerous - will ask whether you can be more than the sum of stolen parts.

Will you return what was taken and become a symbol of uneasy peace? Or carve out your own meaning in defiance of the order that condemned you? In a sky full of shifting loyalties and forged families, the question is no longer what you were made from, but who you will become.

[From [url=https://carpathian-skies.fandom.com/wiki/Carpathian_Skies_Wiki]the official wiki[/url]]
